nary_nodes.label: UEFA boycotts FIFA competitions
evidence: European soccer's governing body has retained its threat to boycott FIFA competitions despite FIFA apologising for its failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup.
UEFA on Thursday reiterated that it had lost confidence in FIFA president Gianni Infantino and said conditions to withdraw its boycott threat had not been met.
UEFA voted to abandon FIFA competitions if it went ahead.

nary_nodes.label: FIFA summit in Morocco
evidence: FIFA and Infantino tried to present a united front following a high-level summit in Morocco on Wednesday when it announced the president had the full support of top staff in attendance.
